title: Speedtest Lease Response
description: Server response to a speedtest lease request. Status is either granted or refused. Contains only a lease decision — no commands, no scripts. The probe_endpoint field is a hostname the agent connects to using its built-in protocol, not a URL to fetch.

lease_token.description: Opaque token. Must be included verbatim in the subsequent measurement result. Present only when status is granted.

expires_at.description: Unix timestamp after which this lease is void. The agent must not start a test it cannot finish before this time. Present only when status is granted.

probe_id.description: Identifier of the probe to test against. Present only when status is granted.

probe_endpoint.description: Hostname of the probe server. The agent connects using its built-in RMBT protocol. Present only when status is granted.

max_duration_secs.description: The agent must not run the test longer than this. Present only when status is granted.

max_streams.description: The agent must not use more parallel streams than this. Present only when status is granted.

error_code.description: Machine-readable error code. Present when status is refused.

error_message.description: Human-readable description. Present when status is refused.

retry_after_secs.description: How many seconds to wait before requesting another lease. Present when status is refused.
